text: AI is changing the way we think about creativity. Today, AI tools can create art, compose music, and even write stories or articles. These programs learn from millions of examples and then produce something new. However, there is an important difference between human and machine creativity. Humans create from emotions, personal experiences, and imagination. AI simply recognises patterns and combines information. It does not understand what it makes or feel proud of it. So, while AI is a powerful tool that can help artists and writers, real creativity still comes from people. AI can support our ideas, but it cannot replace the human heart behind them.
